# Designed for Your Life: 7 Features to Love in a New Utah Home


The right home has features that bring comfort and possibility to everyday life and design that makes room for the moments that matter.


Tri Pointe Homes Utah


•


November 9, 2026


Share this article


A morning that starts with everything close at hand. A quiet place to focus. An outdoor gathering that lasts a little longer. At[Canyon Park](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/canyon-park) in Orem and[The Crossings at Lake Creek](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/the-crossings-at-lake-creek) in Heber City, Tri Pointe Homes® brings thoughtful design to the way you want to live. As you explore your next move, discover seven features worth putting on your new home wish list.


## 1. Main Floor Primary Suites for Everyday Ease


Having your primary suite on the main floor brings your personal retreat closer to the spaces you use most. Start the morning with an easy transition from bedroom to kitchen, or settle in after a day outdoors without heading upstairs.


Canyon Park and The Crossings both offer multiple home designs featuring a main-level primary suite. Some designs, such as The Crossings Aspen plan, pair this convenience with secondary bedrooms upstairs. It’s an appealing arrangement for homeowners who want a comfortable daily routine with separation between their retreat and other bedrooms.

##


## 2. Covered Outdoor Living That Invites You to Stay


From a leisurely breakfast to dinner with friends, covered outdoor living gives everyday moments a refreshing change of scenery.


In Canyon Park’s Cascade and Summit’s Alpine, the main living areas connect to covered outdoor spaces, making it easy to move between preparing a meal and enjoying it outside. Add comfortable seating and imagine a favorite spot to unwind, enjoy the fresh air, and extend your gathering beyond the great room.


**Explore Outdoor Living:**


**Canyon Park**


[Cascade](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/canyon-park/cascade-plan-1-canyon-park)


**The Crossings**


[Alpine](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/summit-collection-at-the-crossings/Alpine-plan-7-summit-collection-at-the-crossings)


## 3. A Dedicated Office That Works for You


A thoughtfully placed office gives work its own space while keeping home life within reach.


Canyon Park’s Highcrest includes a dedicated home office that creates a destination for focused projects, video calls, or managing the household calendar. At The Crossings, Alpine offers an office or gym space, and Aspen includes an office with an available guest-bedroom conversion.


Whether you work remotely every day or simply appreciate a place to concentrate, a room with a clear purpose can make your home feel more organized and your routine more balanced.


**Productivity Within Reach:**


**Canyon Park**


[Highcrest](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/canyon-park/highcrest-plan-3-canyon-park)


**The Crossings**


## 4. A Three Bay Garage for Life Beyond the Driveway


Utah adventures often come with equipment. A three-bay garage gives you more flexibility to accommodate vehicles alongside bikes, skis, camping supplies or seasonal storage, depending on how you arrange the space.


Canyon Park and both the Summit and Timberline collections at The Crossings feature three-bay garages. The added capacity can help keep outdoor essentials organized and ready for the next outing while making everyday arrivals and departures feel a little easier.


**See the Plans:**


[Canyon Park](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/canyon-park)


[The Timberline Collection, The Crossings at Lake Creek](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/timberline-collection-at-the-crossings)


[The Summit Collection, The Crossings at Lake Creek](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/summit-collection-at-the-crossings)


## 5. Personalization That Makes Home Feel Like You


One of the pleasures of buying a new home is the opportunity to make thoughtful selections that reflect your taste. Through Tri Pointe Homes’ Design Studio experience, a Design Consultant helps you explore available choices with your style, floorplan and budget in mind.


At The Crossings and Canyon Park, available options also let you explore different possibilities for offices, basements and primary baths. From the way a room functions to the details that give it character, personalization helps you create a home that feels distinctly yours.


## 6. Unfinished Space With Room for Your Next Chapter


Whether you have changing needs or simply want room for something new down the line, extra space gives you possibilities to consider.


Timberline’s Aspen includes a standard unfinished basement with approximately 1,889 square feet, offering storage and future flexibility. Its available finished-basement configuration adds a recreation room, two bedrooms and a full bath. Whether you envision a future gathering space or need additional finished rooms from the start, exploring these choices helps you plan around both today’s priorities and tomorrow’s possibilities.


## 7. A Main Floor Guest Suite for Welcoming Others


Comfortable accommodation makes it easier to share your home with the people you love. A main-floor guest suite can give visitors a convenient retreat, and the option for a GenSmart Suite® configuration offers another way to consider multigenerational living.


Tri Pointe’s Timpanogos plan, offered at both Canyon Park and The Crossings, has an included main-level GenSmart Suite configuration which features not only a bedroom, but additional living space. For extended visits or a household that spans generations, these layouts can help balance time together with room for individual routines.


**See the Plan:**


**Timpanogos**


[Canyon Park](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/canyon-park/timpanogos-plan-5-canyon-park) |[The Crossings at Lake Creek](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ut/salt-lake-city/summit-collection-at-the-crossings/Timpanogos-plan-12-summit-collection-at-the-crossings)


## Find the Design That Fits Your Utah Lifestyle


Canyon Park pairs its Orem location with a neighborhood park and mountain vistas. The Crossings at Lake Creek connects thoughtfully designed homes with Heber City living, scenic trails and open space. Explore the floorplans, picture your daily routine, and schedule a tour to[see which spaces feel right for you.](https://www.tripointehomes.com/find-your-home/ut/salt-lake-city?type=neighborhoods)
